blocks.text: If you're planning a fishing trip, you will need a place to stay.  The following businesses and rental homes have partnered with Baxstar to provide our customers with the best possible experience when visiting lakes country.  Click business name or image to go to their website.

The Lodge on Detroit

Enjoy luxury amenities and an incredible view of Detroit Lake when you stay at the Best Western Premier Lodge.  When you're done fishing, get a deep tissue massage at the Spa Within , a full functioning day Spa located on the lower level!  What's more, if you bring your own boat you can moor your boat to their dock for the duration of your stay.

Lakes Inn at Dunvilla

This is a local gem!  For those looking for peace and quiet with all the luxuries of a modern hotel, look no further!  The Lakes Inn at Dunvilla offers spacious rooms, a pool and hot tub, and a hot breakfast in the morning.  Located near Pelican Lake, plus lakes Lizzie, Franklin, and Lida, you're only a stone's throw from great fishing and recreation.

218 ESCAPES

Our first recommendation when it comes to finding a vacation home rental in the Lakes Area.  218 Escapes offers 3 cabins on Lake Sallie in Detroit Lakes.  Call Paul today to book your very own lake cabin!

Cotton Lake Airbnb

Jason rents out his cabin on Cotton Lake year-round.  Located 9 miles from Detroit Lakes, Cotton Lake is an excellent fishing lake.  With 4 bedrooms, 9 beds, and 2 baths and Jason's cabin has room for 11 guests.  Oh, and did we mention there is a hot tub?  Click on the picture to see more information.

Country Campground

A family oriented campground located in the heart of lakes country, just 4 miles south of Detroit Lakes.

Karinall Estate on The Lake

A year-round Bed and Breakfast located 2 miles south of Frazee on Wymer Lake.
